newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 stainless steel import seen at 150,000 T.
newsitem.headline: China '97 stainless steel import seen at 150,000 T.

text.p: China is expected to produce 150,000 tonnes of stainless steel in 1997 and import another 150,000 tonnes to meet domestic demand, an official of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry said on Monday.

China's stainless steel output in 1997 is forecast to equal last year's level of 150,000 tonnes, the official said. Taiyuan Iron and Steel Co, China's biggest producer, turned out 50,000-60,000 tonnes.
Domestic demand is forecast at 300,000 tonnes in 1997, he said, adding that China would rely on imports to meet the shortfall.
"The domestic market is currently weak," the official said by telephone. Many Chinese shops are strapped for cash.
But China's consumption of stainless steel was expected to rise in the long term, he said, without giving further details.
